channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: French-Iranian Persepolis author Marjane Satrapi dies of ‘sadness’
item.description: Satrapi's autobiographical novel was born from her experiences of Iran's Islamic revolution and war with Iraq.

item.title: Iran war day 98: Tehran raises doubts on deal as Lebanon fighting continues
item.description: Israel strikes Lebanon despite ceasefire, while Hezbollah rejects deal as death toll tops 3,500.

item.title: Iran war live: Hezbollah rejects truce as Israel continues Lebanon strikes
item.description: Israel's supreme court annuls government ban on international Red Cross visiting Palestinian prisoners in Israeli jails.

item.title: Lebanon latest: Hezbollah rejects US plan as Israel continues attacks
item.description: Al Jazeera’s Obaida Hitto has the latest from Lebanon where a new diplomatic push has done little to quell violence.

item.title: Hezbollah rejects US-brokered ceasefire deal between Israel and Lebanon
item.description: Hezbollah has condemned a US-brokered ceasefire framework accepted by Israel and Lebanon

item.title: Russia kills 12 in Ukraine as Kyiv mourns 707 children killed since 2022
item.description: Russia's latest attacks come as Ukraine commemorates the children killed by Russia over the course of the all-out war.

item.title: Zelensky proposes face-to-face talks in open letter to Putin
item.description: Ukraine's president tells the Russian leader that only "direct engagement" between the two countries could end the war, with the US focused on Iran.

item.title: Hezbollah rejects renewed ceasefire agreed by Israel and Lebanon
item.description: The United States announced the ceasefire agreement on Wednesday night following a fresh round of talks.

item.title: Trump hits back at 'unpatriotic' vote after House rebukes him over Iran
item.description: The lower chamber of Congress passed a measure that seeks to halt further military action, in a vote seen as largely symbolic.

item.title: Oscar-nominated Persepolis author Marjane Satrapi dies aged 56
item.description: The French-Iranian author and illustrator was known for her graphic novel series and Oscar-nominated film.
